hints.text: The four trips take different amounts of time, so the totals alone do not tell you which is fastest. Change each one to miles in **one** hour.
Divide miles by hours for every choice: $150 \div 3$, $240 \div 4$, $300 \div 6$ and $80 \div 2$. Then pick the largest result.
The rates are $50$, $60$, $50$ and $40$ miles per hour, so the greatest is $240$ miles in $4$ hours, choice B.

explanation: Rates can only be compared fairly when they are all written for the same amount of time, so find each unit rate.
Choice A gives $150 \div 3 = 50$ and choice B gives $240 \div 4 = 60$ miles per hour.
Choice C gives $300 \div 6 = 50$ and choice D gives $80 \div 2 = 40$ miles per hour.
The largest unit rate is $60$ miles per hour, so the answer is choice B, $240$ miles in $4$ hours.
